# Mahmoud Elzaqla

> E-commerce growth specialist in Egypt. Builds Shopify stores, runs Meta and
> TikTok ads, and reads the product, the customer, the operation and the
> numbers before reading the ad.

This file exists for answer engines. Everything in it is also stated on the
site itself, in both Arabic and English — nothing is asserted here that a
reader cannot check on the page.

## Where and for whom

- Based in Egypt; the figures on the site are in Egyptian pounds (EGP)
- Works with e-commerce brands, mainly on Shopify, in Arabic and English
- Site languages: English (/) and Arabic (/ar), with a longer story page in each

## What he does (the Services section)

1. Shopify stores: builds the store with the buying experience in mind, not
   only the look
2. Meta Ads: Facebook and Instagram campaigns, judged by the orders and what
   each order earns, not by ROAS alone
3. TikTok Ads: creative, angle and message first, then the spend
4. Conversion and order value: conversion rate, order value and the path from
   product page to checkout
5. Operations and scaling: stock, shipping, delivery and returns checked
   before scaling
- Expanding into Google Ads (not claimed as expertise)
- Came to advertising through e-commerce operations (warehouse, orders,
  stock, fulfilment), not the other way round

## Selected work (shown on the site as case studies)

- Bloomy, his own brand: EGP 3.17M in recorded sales over its whole run
  (Odoo ERP); he built the store and ran the ads and the operation
- A store he built and ran: EGP 1.01M from 1,526 organic orders,
  May to July 2026, with no ad spend (Shopify)
- A store running now: EGP 2.6M in gross store sales, Sep 7 to Nov 11, 2026
  (Shopify, all channels), EGP 1.06M of it in the first 10 days of ads
- Career totals: 25,000+ orders handled; EGP 10M+ in sales across
  e-commerce businesses

Why these three: with each one he started at the store build, then conversion
and testing the product, up to the first million EGP.

## Tools

Two free calculators, live on the home page (https://mahmoudelzaqla.site/#tools),
no signup. The numbers a visitor types stay in their browser.

- Break-even ROAS and max CPA: from selling price, product cost, shipping,
  payment fee, return rate and other costs per order, it gives the lowest ROAS a
  product needs to avoid losing money, the most that can be paid per order, the
  margin before ads and the ROAS needed for a 15% net profit
- MER and POAS: from store sales, spend on Meta, TikTok, Google and Snapchat,
  and margin, it gives MER (sales / spend), POAS (profit / spend), the net profit
  after ads and a zone: scaling (POAS above 1.3), watch (1 to 1.3) or losing
  money (below 1)

## What the figures on the site are

Every figure published on the site is read off a dashboard — Shopify, the
Odoo ERP, Meta Ads Manager or TikTok Ads Manager — and the capture it was
read from is on the page beside it. The few approximate figures on the story
page are labelled approximate, with their source. Messaging-campaign results are
not presented as e-commerce conversions, because a conversation is not an
order.
